_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Craft Acceptance Test Index
summary: The Craft Acceptance Test Index provides a complete listing of all Craft Industrial Test Procedures to be conducted during a craft test program.
use_relationship:
The Craft Acceptance Test Index provides a complete listing of all Craft Industrial Test Procedures to be conducted during a craft test program.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task required as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Acceptance Test Index shall be presented in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Craft Acceptance Test Index shall list by test number and title all contractor and Government-provided stage 2 through 7 shipboard industrial test procedures to be conducted during the Craft Test Program. The Craft Acceptance Test Index shall be comprised of the following parts:

children.title: Title/Cover sheet.
children.content: The Title/Cover Sheet shall contain a clear and direct statement as to the nature of the material to follow in the Craft Acceptance Test Index. The Title/Cover sheet shall include the following information:

children.title: Title; i.e., Craft Acceptance Test Index
Craft identification; i.e., craft hull number
Revision Record.
children.content: The revision record shall describe each change that is made to a revised page. It shall be in tabular format. The revision record shall include the following elements:

children.title: Description of revision, i.e., addition, deletion, modification
Cause for the revision, i.e., Test Change Proposal (TCP) number, Test Problem Report (TPR) number, Engineering Change Proposal (ECP) number, etc.
Index Listing.
children.content: The Index Listing shall be tabular and include the following information for each test procedure:

children.title: Test procedure revision and change level
Test procedure preparation responsibility (contractor or Government)
Index Listing Sort.
children.content: The primary sort for the listing shall be presented by test procedure number sequenced by using the five-digit Expanded Ship Work Breakdown Structure (ESWBS) or the NAVSEA Group (publication 0900-LP-039-9010)(i.e., 000,100,200,300,400,500,600,and 700) as applicable. Within each ESWBS Group the test procedure numbers shall be sequenced in order by SWBS SUBGROUP and ELEMENT (i.e., 242,243,244) or five-digit ESWBS, test stage number, and test serial number.
